    Latest news

    • Featured

      What's new for Term 3

      20 July 2026

      Information for schools this term.

      Find out more

    • Some Ministry regulatory functions transfer to Education Review Office

      30 July 2026

      Regulatory functions for early childhood education services, private schools and school hostels are being transferred to the Education Review Office (ERO) from 1 September 2026.

      Find out more

    • Entries for Ngarimu video and waiata composition competitions close soon

      28 July 2026

      Applications for the Ngarimu video and waiata composition competitions close this Sunday 2 August 2026.

      Find out more

    • ECAC minutes June 2026

      27 July 2026

      Minutes, actions, attendees from the Early Childhood Advisory Committee (ECAC). It met from 9:30am to 3:10pm on Wednesday 24 June 2026 at Mercy Conference Centre, 15 Guildford Terrace, Wellington.

      Find out more

    Tukuna mai ō whakaaro

    Have your say

    View all public consultations

    • Consultation open on third group of senior secondary curriculum subjects

      openCloses: 3 August 2026

      The third group of subjects in the new curriculum is now available for you to review and provide your feedback.

      Find out more

    • Consultation on early childhood education funding system

      openCloses: 6 August 2026

      The Early Childhood Education (ECE) Funding System Ministerial Advisory Group (MAG) is consulting on possible change to how the Government spends $3 billion each year on ECE.

      Find out more

    • Upper Hutt School proposed enrolment scheme amendment

      openCloses: 7 August 2026

      We are proposing an amendment to the enrolment scheme at Upper Hutt School.

      Find out more
